name: posterly
title_zh: 把学术海报编译成单文件 HTML 并打印为 PDF
tagline_zh: 投 ICML/NeurIPS 前最后一晚，别再用 PPT 对齐文本框。一条命令出排版严谨的学术海报。
tagline_en: Last night before the ICML deadline, stop aligning text boxes in PPT. One command turns your research into a.
desc_en: Build an academic conference poster (ICML/NeurIPS/ICLR/CVPR/etc.) as a single HTML/CSS file and render it to print-ready PDF via headless Chromium. Use when user says \"做海报\", \"poster\", \"ICML/NeurIPS/ICLR poster\", or asks to design/edit a research poster.
why_zh: 把海报当代码写：HTML/CSS 即源文件，改字体、调布局全靠 diff，版本管理天然成立。
why_en: Poster as code: HTML/CSS is the source, diffs handle revisions, and Chromium rendering guarantees what you see in the browser is.
limit_zh: 只认学术会议模板（ICML/NeurIPS/ICLR/CVPR 等），非学术海报会缺样式骨架。本机需装 Chromiu。
limit_en: Only academic conference templates (ICML/NeurIPS/ICLR/CVPR). Needs Chromium/Chrome installed. No vector embedding—insert figures as PNG/SVG first.
